errorScreen.title: We couldn't load your profile
errorScreen.message: Check your connection and try again. If the problem persists, sign out and sign back in.

partner.title: Your partner
partner.noneText: Connect with your partner to start earning points together

unlink.title: Unlink partner

delete.message: Are you sure you want to delete your account? All your data, points and progress will be lost permanently. This action can't be undone.
delete.confirmMessage: This is your last chance. Do you want to delete your account for good?
delete.errorMessage: Couldn't delete your account. Try again.

signOutPrompt.title: Sign out
signOutPrompt.message: Are you sure you want to sign out?

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.externalText: Your account is linked to an external provider (Google/Apple). You can't change the password here.
changePassword.symbolRule: Must contain at least one symbol (e.g. !@#$)
changePassword.successMessage: Your password has been changed successfully

discard.title: Discard changes
discard.message: You'll lose the passwords you haven't saved yet.
